description: This file defines the AccountsListViewSmarty class, a custom view class extending ListViewSmarty, used for rendering and processing the accounts list view in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for building action links, handling export, and adding accounts to target lists with embedded JavaScript for UI interactions.

classes.name: AccountsListViewSmarty
classes.description: A custom Smarty view class for the Accounts module, providing additional UI elements and processing logic specific to managing account lists in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the AccountsListViewSmarty object and sets the targetList flag to true.

methods.name: buildAddAccountContactsToTargetList
methods.description: Generates a JavaScript snippet wrapped in an HTML link to add selected accounts and contacts to a target list, including dynamic form creation and a popup window.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Overrides the parent process method to add custom menu items, handle export links based on ACL permissions, and invoke parent processing.

methods.name: buildActionsLink
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to swap button positions in the actions menu for customization.

methods.name: buildExportLink
methods.description: Builds the export link with additional JavaScript for map display, incorporating preferences from ACL checks and configuration.
